long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Porto within Portugal's leading cork dynasty, Paula Amorim entered the family holding while still in her early twenties. She moved through real-estate, forestry and agricultural responsibilities before succeeding her father in group governance. At Galp, she progressed from director to non-executive chair, representing the family's most consequential current investment.

Amorim also developed a separate consumer-facing portfolio. She acquired Fashion Clinic in 2005, then formed Amorim Luxury to combine designer retail with restaurants and hotels. Its brands now include JNcQUOI, PAULA and House of Capricorn, alongside hospitality projects in Lisbon and Comporta. The venture gives her a founder's role distinct from her inherited family-shareholding responsibilities.
